ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
trainstation is a tool that allows the efficient construction of
linear models. It provides supplementary functionality for handling
data and model metrics and relies on the scikit-learn library for the
actual training. trainstation has been originally developed to aid
the construction of force constant (via hiphive) andcluster expansions
(via icet). Since it has proven to be valuable in more general
contexts and to simplify the maintenance of the two aforementioned
packages, the functionality has been moved into a separate package.

name: trainstation
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: trainstation
  version: "1.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/trainstation-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e2cda1716a09f98930aa34640bdb2ac05e49e675afe54979d81657f3fac37d9b

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - numpy >=1.12
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - scikit-learn
    - scipy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - trainstation
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Convenient training of linear models
  description: |
    trainstation is a tool that allows the efficient construction of
    linear models. It provides supplementary functionality for handling
    data and model metrics and relies on the scikit-learn library for the
    actual training. trainstation has been originally developed to aid
    the construction of force constant (via hiphive) andcluster expansions
    (via icet). Since it has proven to be valuable in more general
    contexts and to simplify the maintenance of the two aforementioned
    packages, the functionality has been moved into a separate package.
  homepage: http://trainstation.materialsmodeling.org/
  repository: https://gitlab.com/materials-modeling/trainstation
  documentation: http://trainstation.materialsmodeling.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
